    Full experience, real impactTraining that transforms

    Megafest Training Forum brings together speakers, trainers and practitioners for three days of focused learning. Come on your own or bring your whole team. There is a track built for where you are right now.

    Individuals

    • Access to all keynotes and the main hall
    • Choice of breakout tracks each day
    • Workbooks and session notes
    • Mentor connect sessions
    • Entry to the expo hall
    • Certificate of attendance

    Organisations

    • Group passes for teams of 5 or more
    • Reserved seating in the main hall
    • Leadership development track for managers
    • Exhibitor and sponsorship packages
    • Brand visibility in the expo hall
    • Post-forum team debrief resources
